keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Bolton Wanderers 0, Portsmouth 1. Josh Murphy (Portsmouth) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Terry Devlin with a cross.
Goal! Bolton Wanderers 1, Portsmouth 1. Sam Dalby (Bolton Wanderers) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Max Conway with a cross.
Abu Kamara (Portsmouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Josh Sheehan (Bolton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Bolton Wanderers 1, Portsmouth 1.
Second Half begins Bolton Wanderers 1, Portsmouth 1.
Delay in match because of an injury Luca Stephenson (Bolton Wanderers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Ryan Kavuma-McQueen replaces Josh Murphy.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Iyad Mohamed replaces Terry Devlin.
Luca Stephenson (Bolton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jayden Meghoma (Portsmouth) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Atsuki Ito replaces Rúben Rodrigues.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Thomas Waddingham replaces Abu Kamara.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Eoin Kenny replaces Adrian Segecic.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Max Lott replaces Luca Stephenson.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Thierry Gale replaces Samuel Iling-Junior.
Delay in match because of an injury Gaizka Larrazabal (Bolton Wanderers).
Substitution, Portsmouth. Marlon Pack replaces Odin Bailey.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Chris Forino replaces Gaizka Larrazabal because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Jayden Meghoma (Portsmouth).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half ends, Bolton Wanderers 1, Portsmouth 1.
